newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 6.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the June 7 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Illegal capital flight from Russia amounts to $12-$15 billion every year, says a top Central Bank official.
- The Moscow city administration is planning to invest about $200 million for a major overhaul of the capital's Sheremetyevo II international airport.
- Four Russian journalists, taken hostage in Chechnya more than three months ago, were released on Friday after Russia agreed to sign an agreement on transit of oil in the breakaway republic.

- The investigation into details of Sergei Skorochkin's death in February 1995 proves the former parliament deputy elected from the Liberal Democrats of nationalist Vladimir Zhirinovsky had earlier shot dead two people.
